# highlight.js 11.12.0

Vendored from the official @highlightjs/cdn-assets npm package, version 11.12.0. The license is included in LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause). Files are served locally; no external CDN requests are made by visitors. The common browser bundle and SQL grammar are used. DEP SQL keywords are added in code-highlighting.js.

Official documentation: https://highlightjs.org/ and https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
